hypothesis: R32 shows high future-link support recall but weak exact first-time agreement even without simple cues; preserve baseline peak/support and correct conditional onset timing rather than replace event detection
scope: bounded early probe only: JuneSep fit, OctoberNov R10 selected all phases held; NO December/January/February data
target: six-class first observed queue step, only complete-six-label positive links with NO observed eligible queue in released 13 frames; conditional on a future positive event, not unconditional event probability
features: R10 first-horizon555 minus6 horizon indicators +8 public panel onehot =557; no labels/coverage/mask metadata as input
weights: equal mass per positive window with at least one eligible conditional target, then equal per target link; full positives retained, no negative links needed for conditional head
head: shared eight-panel LightGBM multiclass6, fixed200 rounds/31leaves, CPU4; 1200 trees; no parameter search
adjustment: conditional first-step CDF times base falling tail; blend .5/1 and rescale to identical per-link all-six peak; visible-queue links unchanged; does NOT guarantee support under unknown future eligibility masks or calibrated probabilities
training_gate: >=500 JuneSep conditional positive link views; >=50 per applicable road
held_gate: per-road >=20 known conditional held views; conditional logloss better than JuneSep per-road class prior by>=.02 and accuracy better by>=.03; at least one predeclared .5/1 adjustment has median IoU gain(.1/.2/.35)>=-.01 plus negative false-any+.03/eligibleFP+.005
negative_guard: all eligible held cells; .5 unchanged, no loosening; original R10 JuneSep-only early200 is causal control
limitations: complete-label and positive-event conditioning may select a different subset; overlapping views not independent episodes; support-normalization is a heuristic, not an information-bound claim
